Key Details: Incident Location: Valet area of the Seminole Hard Rock Hollywood in Florida. Condition: Stable and closely monitored, according to a spokesperson. Police Report: The Seminole Police Department confirmed an "incident" occurred and one person was taken to Memorial Regional Hospital with non-life-threatening injuries, though they did not initially name the victim. Police Investigation: Two people were detained, and the scene is secured. This is a developing story based on reporting from TMZ, NBC News, and other media outlets. TMZ NBC News
